title: Chinese Lentil Kabobs
description: Grilled lentil skewers with an aromatic twist, inspired by Saudi Arabian flavors.
instructions: Soak 1 cup of lentils overnight and cook according to package instructions.
Mix cooked lentils with 2 tbsp of rice vinegar, 1 tsp of Saudia Arabian spice blend, and 2 tbsp of lime juice.
Thread the lentil mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with 1/4 cup of olive oil and preheat to medium-high heat.
Grill the lentil skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, until lightly charred.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
